# Mitishell v1.1.1

This release fixes the state in which the font picker and font settings shipped in v1.1.0, plus some other miscellaneous bugs.

## Fixes

- Font settings split into two independent slots. Settings > System now offers a Standard font and a Monospace font at the top of the page.
- The standard slot follows the system UI font when empty instead of pinning a specific font.
- The monospace slot defaults to AdwaitaMono Nerd Font Propo.
- Both Mono and Propo variants of nerd fonts are now listed in the picker.
- `mitishell config set` and config validation now reject an unpatched family outright to avoid having a shell without nerd icons.
- The clock island renders at a larger size and centers on the digits' cap height, so any chosen monospace family sits level with neighboring widgets.
- Fixed a bug where `mitishell version` was reporting the wrong release version.

## Install

Download the archive matching your system and `SHA256SUMS` from this release. Then run:

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing
tar -xzf mitishell-v1.1.1-linux-amd64.tar.gz    # or mitishell-v1.1.1-linux-arm64.tar.gz
cd mitishell-v1.1.1-linux-amd64
make install-prebuilt
quickshell -n -p ~/.local/share/mitishell/shell
```
